status_legend.implemented: Currently implemented and exposed through core interfaces where applicable.
status_legend.partial: Partially implemented today; paper-prescribed scope is not complete.
status_legend.planned: Not implemented yet, but explicitly planned on the roadmap.
status_legend.not_planned: Not implemented and not currently planned on the roadmap.
status_legend.in_progress: Currently being delivered (open PR or active branch); not yet merged to main.
status_legend.blocked_on_owner: Not a status value. Boolean field carried beside status `planned`: scoped, but cannot start until the project owner decides a policy or trust-model question.

technical_protocols.name: Task Decomposition
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Contract-first decomposition exists. Human vs AI allocation is currently advisory metadata only.

technical_protocols.name: Task Assignment
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: RFQ + bid + acceptance into escrow is implemented across MCP, HTTP, and CLI. Identity is self-asserted: bidder addresses are only checked as hex and bid acceptance is authorized by a request-body `caller` string (go-server/internal/bidding/bidding.go:761,823,1131), so Sybil cooldowns key on freely rotatable addresses. No post-funding renegotiation or cancellation-compensation clauses. Implemented as a trust-the-operator marketplace until principal authentication (H8) lands.

technical_protocols.name: Multi-objective Optimization
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Complexity floor and tiered service levels implemented; full dynamic Pareto optimization and trust-adaptive autonomy remain open. The on-chain floor is one raw integer compared against `amount` for every token, so it is unit-unsafe across 18-decimal ETH and 6-decimal USDC (src/TaskEscrowFactory.sol:174; tracked as H11).

technical_protocols.name: Adaptive Coordination
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Static pre-agreed clauses are implemented: milestones, a backup worker that the buyer activates manually after a missed deadline (src/TaskEscrow.sol:555), off-chain checkpoint storage, and stability knobs. The paper's adaptive loop (trigger detection, automatic re-allocation, spec or budget changes) is not implemented. Checkpoint authorship is a string compare against a caller-supplied `committed_by` (go-server/internal/api/handlers.go:1909). Backup activation has known defects: stake scoping, and only the current milestone's deadline is extended (tracked as H7).

technical_protocols.name: Monitoring
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Outcome and process checkpoints with L0/L1 streams are live; richer L2/L3 monitoring and policy negotiation are not complete. Indexer correctness hardening (single-flight, transactional cursor, confirmation depth) is in progress as H2.

technical_protocols.name: Trust and Reputation
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Immutable ledger seed, verifiable credentials, and damped metrics exist; DID-native trust portfolio and stronger human-facing trust tooling remain open. The on-chain counters are ungated: `createEscrow` has no `msg.sender` binding, so any party can stamp outcomes on a named buyer or worker (tracked as H10). No signed completion receipt credential is issued.

technical_protocols.name: Permission Handling
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: DCT attenuation, scoping, and lifecycle are implemented. The principal authz layer is default-deny but not authenticated: HTTP/CLI mint, delegate, and revoke never set `Authenticated` and are always denied (go-server/internal/api/dct.go:116), while MCP marks any non-empty caller string as authenticated (go-server/internal/mcpserver/tools.go:1351). Only the admin-token-gated routes (audit, emergency override; SH1) authenticate. No escrow action requires or consumes a DCT; tokens are a standalone capability ledger. Tokens are DB-backed bearer secrets, not macaroons or biscuits.

technical_protocols.name: Verifiable Task Completion
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Verification paths exist: buyer approval, arbitrator, ZK slot, off-chain attestation chains, and multi-verifier quorum. Gaps: the ZK proof is not bound to the task or escrow (src/TaskEscrow.sol:462-471; src/IZKVerifier.sol passes only circuitId and proof); the quorum game rewards no one, as majority voters are only refunded and abstainers are refunded in full (src/TaskEscrow.sol:935-947); attestation roots are not anchored on-chain (R2); no signed completion credential or buyer dispute bond.

technical_protocols.name: Security
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Emergency controls, stake mechanisms, and signed artifacts are implemented. SH1 is done (PR #55): HTTP emergency and DCT admin routes require a bearer token, HTTP and local MCP emergency access are separate opt-ins, and CORS defaults to deny. Rate limit, body cap, request IDs, client-side signing, stronger identity, prompt-security, TEE, and transport hardening remain open. The owner is a single EOA that is also deployer and treasury on the recorded Base Sepolia deployment.

ethical_dimensions.name: Meaningful Human Control
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Approval and escalation gates exist, but explicit consent/withdrawal and irreversible-action UX controls are not fully productized.

ethical_dimensions.name: Accountability in Long Delegation Chains
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Off-chain attestation chains provide evidence of sub-delegation. Transitive liability is NOT implemented: `parentEscrow` only drives the re-delegation fee surcharge and a buyer-is-parent-worker check (src/TaskEscrowFactory.sol:193-196,444), and a child escrow's outcome never affects its parent. Explicit liability firebreak contracts are planned (item 24).

ethical_dimensions.name: Reliability and Efficiency
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Two service tiers with immutable fee snapshots are implemented. Tier 1 blocks `approveByBuyer`, but the buyer can still `dispute()` during review, which wipes quorum votes and refunds verifier stakes (src/TaskEscrow.sol:485-491; tracked as H13). No mandatory safety floors by task class (item 28), so tier choice stays a per-escrow buyer decision.

ethical_dimensions.name: Social Intelligence
ethical_dimensions.origin: Gap identified during V3 review; captured as roadmap item 29.
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Not implemented yet; planned safeguards address AI-as-delegator behavior in human teams.

ethical_dimensions.name: User Training
ethical_dimensions.origin: Gap identified during V3 review; captured as roadmap item 30.
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Not implemented yet; planned operator training/certification readiness track.

ethical_dimensions.name: Risk of De-skilling
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Delegate preference metadata exists; curriculum-aware routing is planned.

protocol_integrations.notes: Escrow lifecycle and extension tooling integrated (50 tools registered in go-server/internal/mcpserver: 36 enabled by default (including the opt-out events and A2A tools), 14 behind the UCP and emergency opt-ins); deeper monitoring semantics remain future work. Caller identity is a tool argument and is not authenticated (see P4.7).

Agent card and tasks/send persist A2A tasks with a verification_policy and an `escrow_trigger` flag (go-server/internal/a2a/service.go:103-179). Nothing acts on the flag: the adapter never creates or links an escrow, and `UpdateA2ATaskEscrow` (go-server/internal/storage/queries.go:2535) has no callers. The settlement skills in the agent card are advertised, not wired.

Mandate validation, escrow binding, and EIP-3009 funding via the server signer (`Chain.FundWithAuthorization`, go-server/internal/ap2/service.go:238) work. The mandate `signature` is only checked for non-emptiness and never verified (go-server/internal/ap2/service.go:52); fund safety currently rests on the token's own EIP-3009 check. The verification fix is tracked as H1 (separate PR in flight). Funding does not route through x402. No stake-on-bid or clawback semantics.
UCP fulfillment provider implemented as adapter-only projection over shared escrow orchestration with REST/MCP/CLI parity.

A facilitator client exists (go-server/internal/x402: Verify and Settle) and is constructed in go-server/internal/api/router.go:101 when X402_ENABLED is set, then injected into `ap2.Service.X402`. No code calls `.X402`, `Verify`, or `Settle` outside tests, so the client is dead in production. AP2 funding calls the chain directly, and the complexity floor does not use x402. Kept in the tree by owner decision; wire it or remove it in a later change.

Because status is planned, the intended future state is tracked in SH5: when SH5 is implemented, CLI and MCP tools will sign transactions locally, server PRIVATE_KEY will become operator-only, and DID integration (item 26) will build on top of that.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: ERC20/USDC payment support
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented token support natively in escrow contracts instead of relying solely on external payment protocols.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: None material.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Worker stake activation
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Made stake optional and escrow-level configurable to avoid forcing one risk model on all tasks.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Adaptive stake sizing remains open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Milestone-based escrow
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented fixed sequential milestones (max 16) for deterministic settlement and bounded gas/runtime complexity.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Richer non-linear execution graphs remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Backup agent clause
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Used pre-designated backup worker and explicit activation instead of automatic market rematching.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Automated backup discovery remains open. `activateBackup` forfeits the primary's whole stake, and the backup's stake settlement spans all milestones including ones the primary already lost (src/TaskEscrow.sol:576,1095); only the current milestone deadline is extended, from the stale deadline with no `> 0` check (tracked as H7).

roadmap_item_decisions.title: On-chain reputation seed
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Started with immutable counters and outcome events as a conservative substrate before richer trust models.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Portfolio-style DID trust claims remain open. Counters are ungated: `createEscrow` has no `msg.sender` check (tracked as H10).

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Complexity floor parameter
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented a single configurable floor instead of dynamic per-task optimization to keep enforcement simple.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Context-aware floor tuning remains open. The floor is one raw integer compared across tokens with different decimals, so it is unit-unsafe (tracked as H11).

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Task_RFQ + Bid_Object bidding protocol
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented off-chain RFQ/bid negotiation with on-chain escrow formalization only after acceptance.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: None material.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: A2A settlement adapter
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Added escrow-specific fields on A2A task metadata while preserving A2A JSON-RPC compatibility. The adapter records tasks only; it does not create or link escrows.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: `escrow_trigger` is stored but never acted on, and `UpdateA2ATaskEscrow` has no callers. Stronger protocol-level verification slots in broader A2A ecosystem remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: AP2 mandate-to-escrow bridge
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented AP2 mandate validation, escrow binding, and funding through the escrow `fundWithAuthorization` bridge using the server signer. The x402 facilitator client is wired into the service but never invoked.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Mandate signature is never verified (H1, fix in flight). x402 client has no callers. Richer AP2-native conditional state semantics remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Real-time event subscriptions
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented L0/L1 eventing now; left L2/L3 as staged follow-on due privacy and operational concerns.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: L2_COT_TRACE and L3_FULL_STATE are not production features yet.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Emergency response protocol
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Used owner-governed freeze/unfreeze and emergency resolve controls as immediate incident-response baseline.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Decentralized emergency governance remains open. The server key is the factory owner on the recorded deployment; Since SH1 (PR #55), HTTP emergency routes are opt-in and bearer-token-gated; MCP emergency tools are a separate local-stdio opt-in (`MCP_EMERGENCY_ENABLED`) with no token, and grant the attached client owner rights.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Sealed bidding
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Chose commit-reveal over advanced privacy cryptography for early deployability.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Selective-disclosure private bidding remains open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Delegation Capability Tokens (DCTs)
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented DCTs as off-chain attenuated tokens with strict scoping and lifecycle invalidation hooks.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: On-chain/native cross-protocol DCT interoperability remains open. No escrow action requires a DCT; tokens are a standalone capability ledger and are DB-backed bearer secrets rather than macaroons or biscuits.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Canonical token profile hardening
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Applied hard cutover to one canonical profile to avoid long-lived legacy ambiguity.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: None material.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Principal authorization layer for DCT operations
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Added explicit role-aware default-deny authz with auditable decisions. Authentication is incomplete: HTTP and CLI mint, delegate, and revoke are always denied because nothing sets `Authenticated`, MCP trusts caller strings, and only the SH1 admin-token routes (audit, emergency override) authenticate.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: No principal authentication outside the admin token (tracked as H8, blocked on the owner's trust-model decision). Tests inject an `X-Test-Caller` middleware that has no production counterpart. Formal policy verification and richer adaptive policy controls remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Verifiable credentials for bidding
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Used secp256k1 attestation-v1 payloads now with optional issuer_did for forward DID compatibility.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Full DID method lifecycle and revocation networks remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Attestation chains
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented recursive verification and chain-of-custody off-chain to avoid contract bloat and gas overhead.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: On-chain enforceability of full recursive chain validity remains open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Checkpoint/resume
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented off-chain checkpoint artifact registry. The active-worker rule compares the request's `committed_by` string to the stored worker address (go-server/internal/api/handlers.go:1909); it is not authenticated.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Commit rights become real only with H8. Checkpoints are storage only: nothing hands them to a backup worker or binds them to the escrow on-chain. Cryptographic checkpoint execution proofs remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Tiered service levels
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Encoded low-assurance vs high-assurance tiers directly on-chain with fee snapshots and approval constraints.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Governance-level mandatory floors by task class remain open. In Tier 1 the buyer can still call `dispute()` mid-review, wiping quorum votes (tracked as H13).

roadmap_item_decisions.title: ZK verification slot
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented optional verifier integration and proof-hash commitments rather than mandatory ZK in all flows.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: The proof is not bound to `taskSpecHash`, `submissionHash`, or the escrow: `verifyProof(circuitId, proof)` receives no task-specific public inputs, and a verified proof counts as one ordinary approval vote (tracked as H12). Broader circuit ecosystem and proof UX hardening remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Multi-verifier quorum
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented bounded verifier panel, quorum thresholds, and stake economics as practical TrueBit-inspired consensus.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Majority voters are only refunded and abstainers are refunded in full, so with stake > 0 abstaining weakly dominates voting (src/TaskEscrow.sol:935-947); minority stake goes to the buyer. Tier-1 buyers can dispute mid-quorum. Incentive redesign is tracked as H13. Large-scale verification game markets remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Market stability mechanisms
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Applied concrete controls (re-bid cooldowns, surcharge windows, damped reputation) where paper gives directional guidance.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Model calibration and adaptive parameter governance remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Contract-first decomposition tooling
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Made delegate preference and market context advisory in V3 to preserve market openness and reduce false negatives.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Policy-enforced human-routing and optimization remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: UCP fulfillment provider
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented as a minimal adapter over existing escrow semantics, with checkout state projection anchored to escrow terminal settlement and shared orchestration used across transports.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: No material gap for V3 scope; broader protocol evolution remains V4+.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Admin auth for emergency endpoints
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Require bearer authentication for HTTP emergency and DCT admin routes, default HTTP and local stdio MCP emergency access to disabled, and require explicit origin configuration for cross-origin HTTP and WebSocket access. Merged in PR #55.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: No material gap for SH1 scope.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Per-IP rate limiting on POST endpoints
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Per-client-IP token bucket on mutating HTTP methods, keyed by RemoteAddr unless the peer is in TRUSTED_PROXIES, in which case X-Forwarded-For is walked right to left to the first untrusted hop. IPv6 is bucketed by /64. Admin routes are limited on every method before authentication. At table capacity, unseen clients share one overflow bucket. Setting RATE_LIMIT_RPS or RATE_LIMIT_BURST to 0 disables the limit.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: No material gap for SH2 scope.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Request body size cap
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Cap request bodies with http.MaxBytesReader at MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB) and reject oversize reads with HTTP 413.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: No material gap for SH3 scope.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Request ID tracing
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Echo a validated X-Request-ID or a generated UUID on every response, store it with authz.WithRequestID, add it to request-path log records through a context-aware slog handler, and include it in JSON error bodies, A2A JSON-RPC error data, and the WebSocket upgrade response.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: No material gap for SH4 scope.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Agent-owned wallet / client-side signing
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Move participant signing to CLI and MCP clients so buyer, worker, verifier, and arbitrator remain distinct principals; the server becomes operator-only for admin/indexing duties. The MCP part must NOT take a `signing_key` tool argument (keys would land in transcripts and logs); run a local per-agent MCP process that reads its key from the environment.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending. Blocked on the owner's off-chain trust-model decision.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: AP2 mandate signature verification
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Verify the mandate signature (signer binds to `authorization.from`) before funding, instead of relying only on the token's EIP-3009 check.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Fix PR in flight separately; until it merges the signature field is checked for non-emptiness only (go-server/internal/ap2/service.go:52).

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Indexer correctness
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Single-flight `RunOnce`, transactional cursor advance, and a confirmation depth so reorgs and failed handlers cannot skip or reorder events.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: In flight. Today logs are marked processed before the handler succeeds, the cursor can advance past escrows that failed to index, and concurrent runs have no mutual exclusion.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Solidity test base and expanded invariants
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Shared test base and mocks, plus invariant fuzzing across milestones, verifier stakes, ERC20, backup, and emergency paths, before any contract change.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: In flight. The current invariant suite covers only single-shot ETH. Must land before H7.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: CreateEscrow request unification
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: One shared request DTO and parser, with floor and panel validation in the escrow service once, replacing three duplicated copies (HTTP, MCP, UCP).
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: In flight. Prerequisite for H5 and H6.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Fund-recovery parity across MCP, HTTP, and CLI
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Expose timeout refund, arbitrator-timeout claim, cancel-before-funding, milestone timeouts, and `expireNoQuorum` / `expireMilestoneNoQuorum` through all three transports, per the interface-parity rule.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending. Today these paths are reachable only through the UCP adapter, and the no-quorum expiries have no Go binding. Starts after H4.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Generic action adapters and service extraction
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Collapse the near-identical HTTP and MCP escrow-action handlers into shared helpers and move checkpoint, RFQ, and decomposition-finalize logic into services; unify escrow ID resolution (MCP accepts ID or address, HTTP only ID).
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending. Starts after H5.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Contract bug-fix bundle (no owner decision needed)
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Scope backup-worker stake settlement to post-activation milestones; extend backup deadlines for all remaining milestones from max(now, deadline) with checked casts and a required extension > 0; reject 1-element milestone arrays and zero-amount milestones; enforce minimum review, dispute, and arbitrator windows; add `nonReentrant` to `withdrawStake`; reorder `activateBackup` to checks-effects-interactions; restrict `EscrowDeployer.deploy` to the factory.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending. Must keep TaskEscrow under 24,576 B (about 584 B of headroom today). Starts after H3. Redeploy is bundled with the owner-approved contract items (H9-H13) as one v2.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Principal authentication (signed requests)
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Replace request-body `caller`, `committed_by`, and bidder strings with signed requests (EIP-191/712 envelope with nonce and expiry) so off-chain identity checks are cryptographic.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Blocked on the owner's off-chain trust-model decision (trustless participants vs operator-trusted coordinator). Resolves 13b, and gives P4.2, item 16, and R4 enforcement real meaning.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Pull-payment settlement
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Route principal payouts, refunds, worker-stake settlement, and fees through the existing `withdrawable` ledger so a reverting recipient or a blacklisted USDC address cannot brick split dispute or quorum settlement.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Blocked on the owner: changes settlement semantics and SPEC invariant 1. Contract v2 redeploy.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: createEscrow consent model
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Decide who must consent at creation (`msg.sender == buyer`, worker acceptance or signature) before an escrow counts toward reputation or the re-delegation surcharge streak.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Blocked on the owner. Today anyone can create an escrow naming any buyer or worker, which allows reputation and surcharge griefing. Contract v2 redeploy.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Per-token complexity floor
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Key the floor per token (or move it to a USD-denominated off-chain check) so 18-decimal and 6-decimal tokens are not compared raw.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Blocked on the owner: per-token mapping with an allowlist, or drop the on-chain floor. Contract v2 redeploy if on-chain.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: ZK public-input binding
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Bind the verifier's public inputs to chain id, escrow address, milestone, `taskSpecHash`, `submissionHash`, and worker (an `IZKVerifier` interface change), or document the slot as panel-gated proof-carrying evidence only.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Blocked on the owner: interface change vs documentation-only. Contract v2 redeploy if bound.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Quorum incentive design
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Decide whether majority verifiers are paid (protocol fee, per-escrow verifier fee, or redistributed minority stake) and whether Tier-1 buyers may `dispute()` mid-quorum.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Blocked on the owner. Today voting can only lose stake and abstainers are refunded, which inverts the paper's Schelling-game incentive.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: SQLite migration squash
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Squash the 27 SQLite migrations into one baseline before mainnet (hard cutoff).
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Blocked on the owner: forces a re-index of existing testnet databases from the start block.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Remove dead `owner` request-body field
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Remove the `owner` body field (and its `caller` / `committed_by` siblings as authority) as a hard cutoff once principals are authenticated.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Blocked on the owner; sequenced with H8.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Curriculum-aware task routing
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned as intentional skill-preservation routing over pure short-term efficiency optimization.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Liability firebreaks
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned explicit chain stop-gaps: assume non-transitive liability or halt for renewed authority transfer.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Cognitive friction calibration
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned context-adaptive friction to avoid both blind automation and alert fatigue.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Decentralized identifiers (DIDs)
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned migration from address-only identity to DID-backed signatures and trust proofs.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Insurance/liability framework
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned as extra-technical protection for human participants where technical controls are insufficient.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Governance layer
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned mandatory safety floors by task class to prevent competitive races to unsafe low-cost paths.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Entire item is pending.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Social intelligence safeguards
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Added as explicit roadmap item after gap review; operationalizes dignity, anti-micromanagement, and authority-gradient handling.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Newly added item, not implemented.

opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.title: Sealed bidding hardening
opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.why_revisit: Commit-reveal is deployable but still exposed to reveal-withholding and griefing behavior.
tasks: Add anti-grief controls for commit-without-reveal behavior.
Define deterministic fallback rules when top commits are not revealed.
Evaluate transport compatibility across MCP, HTTP, and CLI case by case; avoid compatibility shims unless explicitly requested.

opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.title: Attestation-chain anchoring
opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.why_revisit: Off-chain-only verification is efficient, but stronger non-repudiation is useful for high-assurance disputes. TaskEscrow has about 584 B of size headroom, so anchoring ships without Solidity changes.
tasks: Commit the attestation root inside `submissionHash` (keccak256(abi.encode(deliverableHash, attestationRoot))) and verify it off-chain against the `SubmissionMade` event and the stored chain.
Add proof-of-inclusion retrieval and verification helpers.
Define dispute-time checks for mismatched chain data versus anchored roots.
Revisit a native on-chain root field only if the contract v2 bundle needs it.

opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.title: Market stability parameter recalibration
opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.why_revisit: Static damping/cooldown/surcharge knobs may need tuning, but no traffic data exists yet, so a simulation harness would be speculative.
tasks: Add parameter range guardrails by task class and risk profile.
Add an auditable change log for parameter updates.
Defer the replay/simulation harness and staged governance rollout until real traffic data exists.
